title: Season 2 GOAT Builds and Patch 2.0
text: The Season 2 announcement describes GOAT Builds that can surpass ordinary builder caps, with fixed animations and statistics but access to badges and Cap Breakers. It identifies Patch 2.0 changes to ghost contests and steal animations or penalties. This is an announcement summary, not complete platform-specific patch notes. Do not infer exact balance values or badge requirements from it.
